definitions.coverage: Overlapping diagnostic masks, not mutually exclusive phases or optimizer exposure.
definitions.denominators: triggered counts actual causal takeovers; causal_condition_met also counts completed qualifying windows whose scheduled takeover was never reached. Fixed takeovers have separate attempted/legal denominators. Recovery success and retained training records are separate.
definitions.short_prefix: Before 48 student transitions, the settled-height reference is unavailable: dependent prefix windows/height are null, not negative findings. Expert-window coverage may use a mixed-authority reference and is descriptive only.
definitions.held: 12 completed transitions, both physics samples >=2 fingers >0.1N and height>=settled+2cm; rotation allowed.
definitions.rotation: Palm-relative rotation over the same past12 window exceeds0.2rad; does not identify intent, slip or drop.
definitions.near60: Diagnostic coverage only; native keypoint15mm success unchanged.
definitions.after_first_subgoal: Pre-action native stage>0; task later-goal/insertion motions, not a new success definition.
definitions.authority: Expert recovery and its later insertion do not establish student autonomous success.
